dublinCore.dc:title: 116 HR 3304 RH: National Guard and Reservists Debt Relief Extension Act of 2019
dublinCore.dc:rights: Pursuant to Title 17 Section 105 of the United States Code, this file is not subject to copyright protection and is in the public domain.

action.action-desc: Mr. Cohen (for himself, Mr. Cline, Mr. Burchett, and Ms. Dean) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on the Judiciary
Committed to the Committee of the Whole House on the State of the Union and ordered to be printed

form.official-title: To exempt for an additional 4-year period, from the application of the means-test presumption of abuse under chapter 7, qualifying members of reserve components of the Armed Forces and members of the National Guard who, after September 11, 2001, are called to active duty or to perform a homeland defense activity for not less than 90 days.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the National Guard and Reservists Debt Relief Extension Act of 2019.

section.header: National guard and reservists debt relief amendment
section.text: Section 4(b) of the National Guard and Reservists Debt Relief Act of 2008 (Public Law 110–438; 122 Stat. 5000) is amended by striking 11-year and inserting 15-year.
